name: Cube stats go to the item's own stats
description: Stats added by cube recipes (cubemain mod 1-5 columns) now always land in the item's own stat list. Before this fix the game's stat-list lookup ignored the list state when asked for the item's own list (state 0), so on a set item with 2 or more set pieces equipped the added stats went into an active set bonus list, and on a runeword item they went into the runeword list. Charges and chance-to-cast properties added by D2RCore use the same lookup and are covered too.

patches.description: STATLIST_GetStatListFromUnitStateOrFlag (sub_1402F5B80), state-0 search loop rewritten in place (28 bytes, no cave). Old loop returned the first list in the chain whose flags[+0x1C] & requested & ~0x2000 was non-zero, without checking the list state at +0x20. New loop: mov eax,[rcx+1Ch] / and eax,edi / test eax,0FFFFDFFFh / je next / cmp [rcx+20h],esi / je 2F5C37 (found) / next: mov rcx,[rcx+68h] / test rcx,rcx / jne 2F5C1B / xor ecx,ecx. ESI holds the requested state and is always 0 on this path (state != 0 tail-jumps to the exact-state search at 2F58C0 before reaching here). The removed 5-byte alignment NOP pays for the new cmp/je. Targets kept: 2F5C35 (xor ecx,ecx, jumped to from 2F5C19 when the chain is empty) and 2F5C37 (found).
